metadata.chapter_subtitle: Predicting spatial fields from spectral and environmental features

inventory.summary: The chapter's modelling spine was strong, but it needed better learner-facing onboarding and a couple of math-markup repairs so the notation did not interrupt the flow.
issues: The chapter opened abruptly for first-time readers entering the topic-library machine-learning section.
A few malformed currency and inline-math fragments disrupted the explanation.
The chapter needed explicit framing around why spatial validation matters in geographic regression.

rewrite.summary: Revised the opening scaffolding, clarified the learning arc, and repaired notation glitches while preserving the chapter's technical depth.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start block to make prerequisites and goals explicit.
Kept the mathematical derivation intact because it already matched the topic-library level.
Repaired malformed inline math in the learning-rate and cross-validation sections.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now introduces the regression workflow more cleanly, keeps notation readable, and remains technically appropriate for an intermediate specialist volume.

repair.summary: The machine-learning onboarding gap was repaired by adding clearer chapter framing and by fixing the local notation errors.
actions_taken: Added a Before You Start section.
Repaired malformed inline math and currency-style markup.
Kept the derivation sequence but made the chapter entry more pedagogically fair.

design_review.summary: The existing figures and worked examples already carried the concept well, and the added onboarding improves how readers approach those materials.
improvements_made: Added learner-facing prerequisite guidance before the main exposition.
Preserved the worked examples and technical visuals already present in the chapter.
Reduced avoidable friction from malformed notation.
